local weekdays = {"Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"}
local months = {
    "January",
    "February",
    "March",
    "April",
    "May",
    "June",
    "July",
    "August",
    "September",
    "October",
    "November",
    "December"
}
local monthDays = {31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31}
local function fail(message)
    error({command_error = true, message = message}, 0)
end
local function digits(text, minimum, maximum)
    return #text >= minimum and #text <= maximum and text:match("^[0-9]+$") ~= nil
end
local function words(text)
    local result = {}
    for word in text:gmatch("[^ ]+") do
        result[#result + 1] = word
    end
    return result
end
local function split(text, delimiter)
    local result, start = {}, 1
    while true do
        local position = text:find(delimiter, start, true)
        if not position then
            result[#result + 1] = text:sub(start)
            return result
        end
        result[#result + 1] = text:sub(start, position - 1)
        start = position + #delimiter
    end
end
local function tail(values, start)
    local result = {}
    for i = start, #values do
        result[#result + 1] = values[i]
    end
    return result
end
local function sortedKeys(values)
    local result = {}
    for key in pairs(values) do
        result[#result + 1] = key
    end
    table.sort(result)
    return result
end
local function asciiLess(a, b)
    for i = 1, math.min(#a, #b) do
        if a:byte(i) ~= b:byte(i) then
            return a:byte(i) < b:byte(i)
        end
    end
    return #a < #b
end
local function leap(year)
    return year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 ~= 0 or year % 400 == 0)
end
local function monthLength(year, month)
    return month == 2 and leap(year) and 29 or monthDays[month]
end

local CivilDate = {}
CivilDate.__index = CivilDate
function CivilDate.new(year, month, day)
    local number = day - 1
    for y = 2000, year - 1 do
        number = number + (leap(y) and 366 or 365)
    end
    for m = 1, month - 1 do
        number = number + monthLength(year, m)
    end
    return setmetatable(
        {year = year, month = month, day = day, number = number, weekday = (number + 6) % 7},
        CivilDate
    )
end
function CivilDate.fromNumber(number)
    local rest, year, month = number, 2000, 1
    while rest >= (leap(year) and 366 or 365) do
        rest = rest - (leap(year) and 366 or 365)
        year = year + 1
    end
    while rest >= monthLength(year, month) do
        rest = rest - monthLength(year, month)
        month = month + 1
    end
    return setmetatable(
        {year = year, month = month, day = rest + 1, number = number, weekday = (number + 6) % 7},
        CivilDate
    )
end
function CivilDate.parse(text)
    if
        #text ~= 10 or text:sub(5, 5) ~= "-" or text:sub(8, 8) ~= "-" or
            not digits(text:sub(1, 4), 4, 4) or
            not digits(text:sub(6, 7), 2, 2) or
            not digits(text:sub(9), 2, 2)
     then
        return nil
    end
    local year, month, day =
        tonumber(text:sub(1, 4), 10),
        tonumber(text:sub(6, 7), 10),
        tonumber(text:sub(9), 10)
    if
        year < 2001 or year > 2098 or month < 1 or month > 12 or day < 1 or
            day > monthLength(year, month)
     then
        return nil
    end
    return CivilDate.new(year, month, day)
end
function CivilDate:dateText()
    return string.format("%04d-%02d-%02d", self.year, self.month, self.day)
end
function CivilDate:__tostring()
    return self:dateText() .. " " .. weekdays[self.weekday + 1]:sub(1, 3)
end
local function readDate(text)
    return CivilDate.parse(text) or fail("invalid date")
end
local function readMinute(dateText, time)
    local date = CivilDate.parse(dateText)
    if
        not date or #time ~= 5 or time:sub(3, 3) ~= ":" or not digits(time:sub(1, 2), 2, 2) or
            not digits(time:sub(4), 2, 2)
     then
        fail("invalid datetime")
    end
    local hour, minute = tonumber(time:sub(1, 2), 10), tonumber(time:sub(4), 10)
    if hour > 23 or minute > 59 then
        fail("invalid datetime")
    end
    return date.number * 1440 + hour * 60 + minute
end
local function readMonth(text)
    if
        #text ~= 7 or text:sub(5, 5) ~= "-" or not digits(text:sub(1, 4), 4, 4) or
            not digits(text:sub(6), 2, 2)
     then
        fail("invalid month")
    end
    local year, month = tonumber(text:sub(1, 4), 10), tonumber(text:sub(6), 10)
    if year < 2001 or year > 2098 or month < 1 or month > 12 then
        fail("invalid month")
    end
    return year, month
end
local function minuteText(minute)
    local date = CivilDate.fromNumber(minute // 1440)
    return date:dateText() ..
        string.format(" %02d:%02d ", minute % 1440 // 60, minute % 60) ..
            weekdays[date.weekday + 1]:sub(1, 3)
end
local function span(minutes)
    return string.format("%dd%02dh%02dm", minutes // 1440, minutes % 1440 // 60, minutes % 60)
end
local function checkWindow(low, high)
    if low > high then
        fail("invalid window")
    end
    if high - low > 44640 then
        fail("window too long")
    end
end

local fieldNames = {"minute", "hour", "day-of-month", "month", "day-of-week"}
local minimum, maximum = {0, 0, 1, 1, 0}, {59, 23, 31, 12, 7}
local monthCodes = {
    JAN = 1,
    FEB = 2,
    MAR = 3,
    APR = 4,
    MAY = 5,
    JUN = 6,
    JUL = 7,
    AUG = 8,
    SEP = 9,
    OCT = 10,
    NOV = 11,
    DEC = 12
}
local dayCodes = {SUN = 0, MON = 1, TUE = 2, WED = 3, THU = 4, FRI = 5, SAT = 6}
local macros = {
    ["@yearly"] = "0 0 1 1 *",
    ["@annually"] = "0 0 1 1 *",
    ["@monthly"] = "0 0 1 * *",
    ["@weekly"] = "0 0 * * 0",
    ["@daily"] = "0 0 * * *",
    ["@midnight"] = "0 0 * * *",
    ["@hourly"] = "0 * * * *"
}
local function fieldError(index, reason)
    fail(fieldNames[index] .. " " .. reason)
end
local function readValue(text, index)
    local named = index == 4 and monthCodes[text] or index == 5 and dayCodes[text] or nil
    if named ~= nil then
        return named
    end
    if not digits(text, 1, 2) then
        fieldError(index, "invalid value")
    end
    local value = tonumber(text, 10)
    if value < minimum[index] or value > maximum[index] then
        fieldError(index, "out of range")
    end
    return value
end
local function specialNumber(text, index, upper, size)
    if not digits(text, 1, size or 2) then
        fieldError(index, "invalid value")
    end
    local value = tonumber(text, 10)
    if value < 1 or value > upper then
        fieldError(index, "out of range")
    end
    return value
end
local Special = {}
Special.__index = Special
function Special.new(kind, value, occurrence)
    return setmetatable({kind = kind, value = value or 0, occurrence = occurrence or 0}, Special)
end
function Special:__tostring()
    if self.kind == "last" then
        return "L"
    elseif self.kind == "lastWeekday" then
        return "LW"
    elseif self.kind == "beforeLast" then
        return "L-" .. self.value
    elseif self.kind == "nearestWeekday" then
        return self.value .. "W"
    elseif self.kind == "nthWeekday" then
        return self.value .. "#" .. self.occurrence
    else
        return self.value .. "L"
    end
end
local function readField(text, index)
    local values, specials, seen = {}, {}, {}
    for _, item in ipairs(split(text, ",")) do
        if item == "" then
            fieldError(index, "empty item")
        end
        local special, hash = nil, item:find("#", 1, true)
        if index == 3 and (item:sub(1, 1) == "L" or item:sub(-1) == "W") then
            if item == "L" then
                special = Special.new("last")
            elseif item == "LW" then
                special = Special.new("lastWeekday")
            elseif item:sub(1, 2) == "L-" then
                special = Special.new("beforeLast", specialNumber(item:sub(3), index, 30))
            elseif item:sub(-1) == "W" then
                special = Special.new("nearestWeekday", specialNumber(item:sub(1, -2), index, 31))
            else
                fieldError(index, "invalid value")
            end
        elseif index == 5 and hash then
            local weekday = readValue(item:sub(1, hash - 1), index)
            local occurrence = specialNumber(item:sub(hash + 1), index, 5, 1)
            special = Special.new("nthWeekday", weekday % 7, occurrence)
        elseif index == 5 and #item >= 2 and item:sub(-1) == "L" then
            special = Special.new("lastOccurrence", readValue(item:sub(1, -2), index) % 7)
        end
        if special then
            local canonical = tostring(special)
            if not seen[canonical] then
                seen[canonical] = true
                specials[#specials + 1] = special
            end
        else
            local slash = item:find("/", 1, true)
            local base = slash and item:sub(1, slash - 1) or item
            local low, high, dash = nil, nil, base:find("-", 1, true)
            if base == "*" then
                low, high = minimum[index], maximum[index]
            elseif dash then
                low = readValue(base:sub(1, dash - 1), index)
                high = readValue(base:sub(dash + 1), index)
                if low > high then
                    fieldError(index, "invalid range")
                end
            else
                low = readValue(base, index)
                high = slash and maximum[index] or low
            end
            local step = 1
            if slash then
                local part = item:sub(slash + 1)
                if not digits(part, 1, 2) or tonumber(part, 10) == 0 then
                    fieldError(index, "invalid step")
                end
                step = tonumber(part, 10)
            end
            for value = low, high, step do
                values[index == 5 and value % 7 or value] = true
            end
        end
    end
    return {
        index = index,
        values = sortedKeys(values),
        set = values,
        specials = specials,
        restricted = text:sub(1, 1) ~= "*"
    }
end

local Cron = {}
Cron.__index = Cron
function Cron.parse(input)
    if #input == 1 and input[1]:sub(1, 1) == "@" then
        input = words(macros[input[1]] or fail("unknown macro"))
    end
    if #input ~= 5 then
        fail("field count")
    end
    local fields, daily = {}, {}
    for i = 1, 5 do
        fields[i] = readField(input[i], i)
    end
    for _, hour in ipairs(fields[2].values) do
        for _, minute in ipairs(fields[1].values) do
            daily[#daily + 1] = hour * 60 + minute
        end
    end
    return setmetatable({fields = fields, daily = daily, expanded = table.concat(input, " ")}, Cron)
end
function Cron:orRule()
    return self.fields[3].restricted and self.fields[5].restricted
end
function Cron:rule()
    return self:orRule() and "OR" or "AND"
end
local function nearest(date, day)
    local weekday = (date.number - date.day + day + 6) % 7
    if weekday == 6 then
        return day == 1 and 3 or day - 1
    end
    if weekday == 0 then
        return day == monthLength(date.year, date.month) and day - 2 or day + 1
    end
    return day
end
function Cron:matchDay(date)
    local last, day, weekday = monthLength(date.year, date.month), date.day, date.weekday
    local monthDay, weekDay = self.fields[3].set[day] == true, self.fields[5].set[weekday] == true
    for _, special in ipairs(self.fields[3].specials) do
        local matches
        if special.kind == "last" then
            matches = day == last
        elseif special.kind == "lastWeekday" then
            matches = day == nearest(date, last)
        elseif special.kind == "beforeLast" then
            matches = day == last - special.value
        else
            matches = special.value <= last and day == nearest(date, special.value)
        end
        monthDay = monthDay or matches
    end
    for _, special in ipairs(self.fields[5].specials) do
        local matches
        if special.kind == "nthWeekday" then
            matches = weekday == special.value and (day - 1) // 7 + 1 == special.occurrence
        else
            matches = weekday == special.value and day + 7 > last
        end
        weekDay = weekDay or matches
    end
    local condition
    if self:orRule() then
        condition = monthDay or weekDay
    else
        condition = monthDay and weekDay
    end
    return monthDay, weekDay, condition
end
function Cron:scheduled(date)
    local _, _, condition = self:matchDay(date)
    return self.fields[4].set[date.month] == true and condition
end
function Cron:fireTimes(low, high, holidays, reverse)
    return coroutine.wrap(
        function()
            local first, last = low // 1440, high // 1440
            local step = reverse and -1 or 1
            for day = reverse and last or first, reverse and first or last, step do
                if not holidays[day] and self:scheduled(CivilDate.fromNumber(day)) then
                    for i = reverse and #self.daily or 1, reverse and 1 or #self.daily, step do
                        local time = day * 1440 + self.daily[i]
                        if low <= time and time <= high then
                            coroutine.yield(time)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    )
end
function Cron:reasons(time, holidays)
    local date, result = CivilDate.fromNumber(time // 1440), {}
    local monthDay, weekDay, condition = self:matchDay(date)
    if not self.fields[1].set[time % 60] then
        result[#result + 1] = "minute"
    end
    if not self.fields[2].set[time % 1440 // 60] then
        result[#result + 1] = "hour"
    end
    if not condition and not monthDay then
        result[#result + 1] = "day-of-month"
    end
    if not self.fields[4].set[date.month] then
        result[#result + 1] = "month"
    end
    if not condition and not weekDay then
        result[#result + 1] = "day-of-week"
    end
    if holidays[date.number] then
        result[#result + 1] = "excluded"
    end
    return result
end
local function listJoin(parts, either)
    if #parts < 2 then
        return parts[1] or ""
    end
    return table.concat(parts, ", ", 1, #parts - 1) ..
        (either and " or " or " and ") .. parts[#parts]
end
local function valueName(index, value)
    if index == 4 then
        return months[value]
    end
    if index == 5 then
        return weekdays[value + 1]
    end
    return tostring(value)
end
local function valueList(field, either)
    local parts, values, start = {}, field.values, 1
    while start <= #values do
        local finish = start
        while finish < #values and values[finish + 1] == values[finish] + 1 do
            finish = finish + 1
        end
        if finish - start >= 2 then
            parts[#parts + 1] =
                valueName(field.index, values[start]) ..
                " through " .. valueName(field.index, values[finish])
        else
            for i = start, finish do
                parts[#parts + 1] = valueName(field.index, values[i])
            end
        end
        start = finish + 1
    end
    return listJoin(parts, either)
end
local function stepped(field)
    local values = field.values
    if #values < 2 or values[1] ~= 0 or values[2] < 2 then
        return 0
    end
    local step = values[2]
    if #values ~= maximum[field.index] // step + 1 then
        return 0
    end
    for i, value in ipairs(values) do
        if value ~= (i - 1) * step then
            return 0
        end
    end
    return step
end
function Cron:dayClause(weekday, either)
    local field, parts = self.fields[weekday and 5 or 3], {}
    if #field.values > 0 then
        parts[#parts + 1] =
            weekday and valueList(field, either) or
            ((#field.values == 1 and "day " or "days ") .. valueList(field))
    end
    local ordinals = {"1st", "2nd", "3rd", "4th", "5th"}
    for _, special in ipairs(field.specials) do
        local part
        if special.kind == "last" then
            part = "the last day"
        elseif special.kind == "lastWeekday" then
            part = "the last weekday"
        elseif special.kind == "beforeLast" then
            part =
                special.value ..
                (special.value == 1 and " day" or " days") .. " before the last day"
        elseif special.kind == "nearestWeekday" then
            part = "the weekday nearest day " .. special.value
        elseif special.kind == "nthWeekday" then
            part = "the " .. ordinals[special.occurrence] .. " " .. weekdays[special.value + 1]
        else
            part = "the last " .. weekdays[special.value + 1]
        end
        parts[#parts + 1] = part
    end
    return listJoin(parts, either) ..
        ((not weekday or #field.specials > 0) and " of the month" or "")
end
function Cron:describe()
    local minute, hour, text = self.fields[1], self.fields[2], nil
    if #self.daily <= 4 then
        local times = {}
        for _, time in ipairs(self.daily) do
            times[#times + 1] = string.format("%02d:%02d", time // 60, time % 60)
        end
        text = "At " .. listJoin(times)
    else
        local minuteStep, hourStep = stepped(minute), stepped(hour)
        if #minute.values == 60 then
            text = "Every minute"
        elseif minuteStep ~= 0 then
            text = "Every " .. minuteStep .. " minutes"
        elseif #minute.values == 1 then
            text = "At minute " .. minute.values[1]
        else
            text = "At minutes " .. valueList(minute)
        end
        if #hour.values == 24 then
            if text:sub(1, 9) == "At minute" then
                text = text .. " of every hour"
            end
        elseif hourStep ~= 0 then
            text = text .. ", every " .. hourStep .. " hours"
        elseif hour.values[#hour.values] - hour.values[1] + 1 == #hour.values then
            text =
                text ..
                string.format(
                    ", between %02d:00 and %02d:59",
                    hour.values[1],
                    hour.values[#hour.values]
                )
        else
            text = text .. ", during hours " .. valueList(hour)
        end
    end
    local monthFull, weekFull = #self.fields[3].values == 31, #self.fields[5].values == 7
    if self:orRule() then
        if not monthFull and not weekFull then
            text = text .. ", on " .. self:dayClause(false) .. " or on " .. self:dayClause(true)
        end
    elseif not monthFull and not weekFull then
        text =
            text .. ", on " .. self:dayClause(false) .. " if it is " .. self:dayClause(true, true)
    elseif not monthFull then
        text = text .. ", on " .. self:dayClause(false)
    elseif not weekFull then
        text = text .. ", on " .. self:dayClause(true)
    end
    if #self.fields[4].values ~= 12 then
        text = text .. ", in " .. valueList(self.fields[4])
    end
    return text
end

local arity = {
    JOB = -2,
    VALIDATE = -1,
    REMOVE = 1,
    RENAME = 2,
    ENABLE = 1,
    DISABLE = 1,
    RUNTIME = 3,
    LIST = 0,
    EXPAND = 2,
    DESCRIBE = 1,
    MATCH = 3,
    NEXT = 4,
    PREV = 4,
    COUNT = 5,
    GAP = 3,
    OVERLAP = 6,
    TIMELINE = 4,
    CONFLICTS = 4,
    WEEK = 1,
    CALENDAR = 2,
    SIMULATE = 4,
    EXCLUDE = 1,
    INCLUDE = 1,
    HOLIDAYS = 0
}
local Scheduler = {}
Scheduler.__index = Scheduler
function Scheduler.new()
    return setmetatable({jobs = {}, holidays = {}, holidayCount = 0}, Scheduler)
end
function Scheduler:getJob(id)
    return self.jobs[id] or fail("unknown job")
end
function Scheduler:newId(id)
    if #id < 1 or #id > 16 or not id:match("^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$") then
        fail("invalid id")
    end
    if self.jobs[id] then
        fail("duplicate job")
    end
end
local function positive(text, size, upper, reason)
    if not digits(text, 1, size) or text:sub(1, 1) == "0" or tonumber(text, 10) > upper then
        fail(reason)
    end
    return tonumber(text, 10)
end
function Scheduler:ordered(enabledOnly)
    local result = {}
    for _, job in pairs(self.jobs) do
        if not enabledOnly or job.enabled then
            result[#result + 1] = job
        end
    end
    table.sort(
        result,
        function(a, b)
            return asciiLess(a.id, b.id)
        end
    )
    return result
end
function Scheduler:timeline(low, high, conflicts)
    local schedule = {}
    for _, job in ipairs(self:ordered(true)) do
        for time in job.cron:fireTimes(low, high, self.holidays) do
            schedule[time] = schedule[time] or {}
            schedule[time][#schedule[time] + 1] = job.id
        end
    end
    local times, count, peak = sortedKeys(schedule), 0, 0
    for _, time in ipairs(times) do
        local size = #schedule[time]
        if conflicts then
            if size >= 2 then
                count = count + 1
                peak = math.max(peak, size)
            end
        else
            count = count + size
        end
    end
    local rows = {
        conflicts and ("CONFLICTS " .. count .. " peak " .. peak) or ("TIMELINE " .. count)
    }
    local written = 0
    for _, time in ipairs(times) do
        if written == 100 then
            break
        end
        local ids = schedule[time]
        if conflicts then
            if #ids >= 2 then
                rows[#rows + 1] = minuteText(time) .. " " .. #ids .. " " .. table.concat(ids, " ")
                written = written + 1
            end
        else
            for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
                if written == 100 then
                    break
                end
                rows[#rows + 1] = minuteText(time) .. " " .. id
                written = written + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if count > 100 then
        rows[#rows + 1] = "... " .. (count - 100) .. " more"
    end
    return rows
end
function Scheduler:week(input, start)
    local counts, total, low = {}, 0, start.number * 1440
    for day = 1, 7 do
        counts[day] = {}
        for hour = 1, 24 do
            counts[day][hour] = 0
        end
    end
    for _, job in ipairs(self:ordered(true)) do
        for time in job.cron:fireTimes(low, low + 7 * 1440 - 1, self.holidays) do
            local day, hour = (time - low) // 1440 + 1, time % 1440 // 60 + 1
            counts[day][hour] = counts[day][hour] + 1
            total = total + 1
        end
    end
    local rows = {"WEEK " .. input .. " " .. total}
    for day = 1, 7 do
        local marks, subtotal = {}, 0
        for _, count in ipairs(counts[day]) do
            subtotal = subtotal + count
            marks[#marks + 1] = count == 0 and "." or count >= 10 and "+" or tostring(count)
        end
        rows[#rows + 1] =
            tostring(CivilDate.fromNumber(start.number + day - 1)) ..
            " " .. table.concat(marks) .. " " .. subtotal
    end
    return rows
end
function Scheduler:calendar(job, input, year, month)
    local first, cells, count = CivilDate.new(year, month, 1), {}, 0
    for _ = 1, first.weekday do
        cells[#cells + 1] = "..."
    end
    for day = 1, monthLength(year, month) do
        local date = CivilDate.new(year, month, day)
        local mark = job.cron:scheduled(date) and (self.holidays[date.number] and "x" or "*") or "-"
        if mark == "*" then
            count = count + 1
        end
        cells[#cells + 1] = string.format("%02d%s", day, mark)
    end
    while #cells % 7 ~= 0 do
        cells[#cells + 1] = "..."
    end
    local rows = {
        "CALENDAR " ..
            job.id .. " " .. input .. " days " .. count .. " runs " .. count * #job.cron.daily,
        "Sun Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat"
    }
    for i = 1, #cells, 7 do
        rows[#rows + 1] = table.concat(cells, " ", i, i + 6)
    end
    return rows
end
function Scheduler:simulate(low, high)
    local jobs, events, details = self:ordered(true), {}, {}
    for _, job in ipairs(jobs) do
        local started, skipped, replaced, busy, lastEnd = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
        for time in job.cron:fireTimes(low, high, self.holidays) do
            if lastEnd > time and job.policy == "FORBID" then
                skipped = skipped + 1
            else
                if lastEnd > time and job.policy == "REPLACE" then
                    events[lastEnd] = (events[lastEnd] or 0) + 1
                    events[time] = (events[time] or 0) - 1
                    busy = busy - (lastEnd - time)
                    replaced = replaced + 1
                end
                lastEnd = time + job.duration
                events[time] = (events[time] or 0) + 1
                events[lastEnd] = (events[lastEnd] or 0) - 1
                started = started + 1
                busy = busy + job.duration
            end
        end
        details[#details + 1] =
            job.id ..
            " " ..
                job.policy ..
                    " started " ..
                        started ..
                            " skipped " .. skipped .. " replaced " .. replaced .. " busy " .. busy
    end
    local running, peak, at = 0, 0, 0
    for _, time in ipairs(sortedKeys(events)) do
        running = running + events[time]
        if running > peak then
            peak, at = running, time
        end
    end
    local rows = {
        "SIMULATE " .. #jobs .. " peak " .. peak .. (peak == 0 and "" or " at " .. minuteText(at))
    }
    for _, detail in ipairs(details) do
        rows[#rows + 1] = detail
    end
    return rows
end
function Scheduler:execute(tokens)
    local command, expected = tokens[1], arity[tokens[1]]
    if expected == nil then
        fail("unknown command")
    end
    local count = #tokens - 1
    if expected < 0 and count < -expected or expected >= 0 and count ~= expected then
        fail("wrong arguments")
    end
    if command == "JOB" then
        local id = tokens[2]
        self:newId(id)
        local expression = tail(tokens, 3)
        local cron = Cron.parse(expression)
        self.jobs[id] = {
            id = id,
            cron = cron,
            text = table.concat(expression, " "),
            enabled = true,
            duration = 1,
            policy = "ALLOW"
        }
        return {"JOB " .. id .. " added"}
    elseif command == "VALIDATE" then
        local cron = Cron.parse(tail(tokens, 2))
        return {"VALID " .. cron.expanded .. " " .. cron:rule() .. " " .. #cron.daily}
    elseif command == "REMOVE" then
        local job = self:getJob(tokens[2])
        self.jobs[job.id] = nil
        return {"REMOVE " .. job.id}
    elseif command == "RENAME" then
        local job = self:getJob(tokens[2])
        self:newId(tokens[3])
        self.jobs[job.id] = nil
        job.id = tokens[3]
        self.jobs[job.id] = job
        return {"RENAME " .. tokens[2] .. " " .. job.id}
    elseif command == "ENABLE" or command == "DISABLE" then
        local job, enable = self:getJob(tokens[2]), command == "ENABLE"
        if job.enabled == enable then
            fail(enable and "already enabled" or "already disabled")
        end
        job.enabled = enable
        return {command .. " " .. job.id}
    elseif command == "RUNTIME" then
        local job = self:getJob(tokens[2])
        local duration = positive(tokens[3], 4, 1440, "invalid duration")
        local policy = tokens[4]
        if policy ~= "ALLOW" and policy ~= "FORBID" and policy ~= "REPLACE" then
            fail("invalid policy")
        end
        job.duration, job.policy = duration, policy
        return {"RUNTIME " .. job.id .. " " .. duration .. " " .. policy}
    elseif command == "LIST" then
        local jobs = self:ordered()
        local rows = {"LIST " .. #jobs}
        for _, job in ipairs(jobs) do
            rows[#rows + 1] =
                job.id ..
                (job.enabled and " on " or " off ") ..
                    job.duration .. " " .. job.policy .. " " .. job.text
        end
        return rows
    elseif command == "EXPAND" then
        local job = self:getJob(tokens[2])
        local index
        for i, name in ipairs(fieldNames) do
            if name == tokens[3] then
                index = i
                break
            end
        end
        if not index then
            fail("invalid field")
        end
        local field, items = job.cron.fields[index], {}
        for _, value in ipairs(field.values) do
            items[#items + 1] = tostring(value)
        end
        for _, special in ipairs(field.specials) do
            items[#items + 1] = tostring(special)
        end
        return {
            "EXPAND " ..
                job.id ..
                    " " ..
                        tokens[3] ..
                            " " ..
                                #field.values ..
                                    (#items == 0 and "" or " " .. table.concat(items, " "))
        }
    elseif command == "DESCRIBE" then
        local job = self:getJob(tokens[2])
        return {"DESCRIBE " .. job.id .. " " .. job.cron:describe()}
    elseif command == "MATCH" then
        local job = self:getJob(tokens[2])
        local time = readMinute(tokens[3], tokens[4])
        local reasons = job.cron:reasons(time, self.holidays)
        return {
            "MATCH " ..
                job.id ..
                    " " ..
                        minuteText(time) ..
                            (#reasons == 0 and " yes" or " no " .. table.concat(reasons, " "))
        }
    elseif command == "NEXT" or command == "PREV" then
        local job = self:getJob(tokens[2])
        local start = readMinute(tokens[3], tokens[4])
        local limit = positive(tokens[5], 2, 50, "invalid count")
        local reverse, times = command == "PREV", {}
        for time in job.cron:fireTimes(
            reverse and start - 527040 or start + 1,
            reverse and start - 1 or start + 527040,
            self.holidays,
            reverse
        ) do
            times[#times + 1] = time
            if #times == limit then
                break
            end
        end
        local rows = {command .. " " .. job.id .. " " .. #times}
        for _, time in ipairs(times) do
            rows[#rows + 1] =
                minuteText(time) .. (reverse and " -" or " +") .. span(math.abs(time - start))
        end
        if #times < limit then
            rows[#rows + 1] = "NONE"
        end
        return rows
    elseif command == "COUNT" then
        local job = self:getJob(tokens[2])
        local low = readMinute(tokens[3], tokens[4])
        local high = readMinute(tokens[5], tokens[6])
        checkWindow(low, high)
        local runs, days = 0, {}
        for time in job.cron:fireTimes(low, high, self.holidays) do
            runs = runs + 1
            days[time // 1440] = true
        end
        return {"COUNT " .. job.id .. " runs " .. runs .. " days " .. #sortedKeys(days)}
    elseif command == "GAP" then
        local job = self:getJob(tokens[2])
        local start = readMinute(tokens[3], tokens[4])
        local times = {}
        for time in job.cron:fireTimes(start, start + 44640, self.holidays) do
            times[#times + 1] = time
        end
        if #times < 2 then
            return {"GAP " .. job.id .. " runs " .. #times .. " none"}
        end
        local frequencies, shortest, longest, from = {}, 44641, 0, 1
        for i = 2, #times do
            local gap = times[i] - times[i - 1]
            shortest = math.min(shortest, gap)
            if gap > longest then
                longest, from = gap, i - 1
            end
            frequencies[gap] = (frequencies[gap] or 0) + 1
        end
        local rows = {
            "GAP " ..
                job.id ..
                    " runs " ..
                        #times ..
                            " shortest " ..
                                span(shortest) ..
                                    " longest " ..
                                        span(longest) ..
                                            " from " ..
                                                minuteText(times[from]) ..
                                                    " to " .. minuteText(times[from + 1])
        }
        for _, gap in ipairs(sortedKeys(frequencies)) do
            rows[#rows + 1] = span(gap) .. " " .. frequencies[gap]
        end
        return rows
    elseif command == "OVERLAP" then
        local a = self:getJob(tokens[2])
        local b = self:getJob(tokens[3])
        local low = readMinute(tokens[4], tokens[5])
        local high = readMinute(tokens[6], tokens[7])
        checkWindow(low, high)
        local other, times = {}, {}
        for time in b.cron:fireTimes(low, high, self.holidays) do
            other[time] = true
        end
        for time in a.cron:fireTimes(low, high, self.holidays) do
            if other[time] then
                times[#times + 1] = time
            end
        end
        return {
            "OVERLAP " ..
                a.id ..
                    " " ..
                        b.id ..
                            " " ..
                                #times ..
                                    (#times == 0 and "" or
                                        " first " ..
                                            minuteText(times[1]) ..
                                                " last " .. minuteText(times[#times]))
        }
    elseif command == "TIMELINE" or command == "CONFLICTS" or command == "SIMULATE" then
        local low = readMinute(tokens[2], tokens[3])
        local high = readMinute(tokens[4], tokens[5])
        checkWindow(low, high)
        if command == "SIMULATE" then
            return self:simulate(low, high)
        end
        return self:timeline(low, high, command == "CONFLICTS")
    elseif command == "WEEK" then
        local date = readDate(tokens[2])
        return self:week(tokens[2], date)
    elseif command == "CALENDAR" then
        local job = self:getJob(tokens[2])
        local year, month = readMonth(tokens[3])
        return self:calendar(job, tokens[3], year, month)
    elseif command == "EXCLUDE" or command == "INCLUDE" then
        local date = readDate(tokens[2])
        local day = date.number
        if command == "EXCLUDE" then
            if self.holidays[day] then
                fail("already excluded")
            end
            self.holidays[day] = true
            self.holidayCount = self.holidayCount + 1
        else
            if not self.holidays[day] then
                fail("not excluded")
            end
            self.holidays[day] = nil
            self.holidayCount = self.holidayCount - 1
        end
        return {command .. " " .. tostring(date) .. " holidays " .. self.holidayCount}
    else
        local rows = {"HOLIDAYS " .. self.holidayCount}
        for _, day in ipairs(sortedKeys(self.holidays)) do
            rows[#rows + 1] = tostring(CivilDate.fromNumber(day))
        end
        return rows
    end
end

local first = io.read("*l")
if not first then
    return
end
local scheduler = Scheduler.new()
for _ = 1, tonumber(first, 10) do
    local tokens = words((io.read("*l")):gsub("\r$", ""))
    local ok, result = pcall(scheduler.execute, scheduler, tokens)
    if ok then
        for _, row in ipairs(result) do
            io.write(row, "\n")
        end
    elseif type(result) == "table" and result.command_error then
        io.write("ERROR ", result.message, "\n")
    else
        error(result, 0)
    end
end
